scope: Independent finite static read of prepare_execution command/input/identity assembly and audit_stage field semantics against existing producer source; bounded direct-contract marker/count inspection. No prepare script, tests or models executed by reviewer.

checks.commands: 17 frozen groups, quality ON11 then history ABBA 4x21, six tiers two services x3 each =131 HTTP. Exact mirror-recycle axis 0/1 only; C256/L216/K8 server capacity262144/MTPoff from wrapper/env protocol; matrix target261887 explicitly requests262144 total/257 output.
checks.input_bindings: Producer input_config includes quality manifest+requests or selected performance requests, hot-list, model config/index and reference when supplied; prepare binds all those absolute resolved paths. History uses unique frozen sequence lengths; matrix each fixed tier. Model payload is not hashed.
checks.case_counts: History sequence producer emits21 distinct case names with one response each. Matrix producer emits one case for selected tier with3 responses; audit checks len(result)==1 and final request_count==3, preserving history position fields only when present.
checks.oracle_fields: Quality raw response identity/usage/text/finish compared to bound frozen reference, aggregate exact_match and length_match checked. Performance uses ordered prompt/output digests, exact usage/output limits and finishes; timing recomputed by producer formula.
checks.protocol_identity: Audit checks each producer input/config digest is in execution frozen_files, runtime source/binary/worktree identity, copied tool set/digests, exact effective env, no diagnostic scope, full capacity and owned cleanup. Group PASS is explicitly not performance or numerical acceptance.
checks.cold_limits: Performance only: required pre-service cold-cache rounds<=2 and payload resident0, 226 observed model files,16GiB host/cache max and swap0. Cache metadata not model content; no physical54GB inference.
checks.numerical_markers: Six frozen substrings match actual source: five case/step/layer2/C16/T1/active/changed markers plus BF16_BIT_EXACT=true OFF_ON_FP32_BIT_EXACT=true. Strict required-list selects exactly one named contract and runner enforces PASS1 FAIL0 SKIP0.
checks.identity_freeze: Clean HEAD checked against build source_commit, binary digest matched, source export/build maps later verified by frozen(); all runner/source/command/required-list/review/dependency metadata included in frozen_files. Execution admission remains a separate future record.
checks.exclusive_outputs: JSON save uses exclusive open; per-group command and execution-plan cannot overwrite. Required numerical list now uses open(x), fixing prior exists-check+write_text race before first execution.
